**File:** `backend/api/ivx-deployment-tools.ts` (470 lines)

### `handleInvoke()` — `POST /api/ivx/deploy-tools/invoke`
This is a **fully public endpoint — NO auth at all.** It uses `publicJson()` (not `ownerOnlyJson`), and there is no call to `assertIVXOwnerOnly()` anywhere in `handleInvoke`. The CORS headers allow `https://ivxholding.com`.

### `{"tool":"sync","action":"sync"}` (lines 391–421)

- `assessDeploymentBrain()` — compares local commit vs production commit (drift check)

- Returns brain status, decision, commit match info, deploy result, evidence

## 2. `backend/api/ivx-admin-sync.ts` — Owner-Only Sync Endpoint

**File:** `backend/api/ivx-admin-sync.ts` (387 lines)

### Authentication (line 208)
```typescript
await assertIVXOwnerOnly(request);
```
Requires **owner auth** via `assertIVXOwnerOnly`. No bypass for production. Returns 401 on failure.

### What it does (`handleIVXAdminSyncGithubSyncRequest`, line 205)
This is the **full delivery chain** — `POST /api/ivx/admin/sync-github`:

1. **Reads GitHub creds** from env/Owner Variables (`readGithubCreds()`, line 220) — `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `GITHUB_REPO_URL`, `GITHUB_BRANCH`
2. **Snapshots HEAD before push** — GitHub API `GET /repos/{slug}/git/ref/heads/{branch}` (line 252)
3. **Runs `expo/sync-github.mjs`** as a child process (line 264, `runSyncGithubScript`), injecting `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `GITHUB_REPO_URL`, `GITHUB_REPO`, `GITHUB_BRANCH` into the child env. The script reads the **local filesystem** (`expo/` directory via `getSyncPaths`) and pushes via the **Git Tree API**
4. **Re-reads branch ref** to confirm pushed HEAD SHA (line 272)
5. **Triggers Render deploy** with the new commit SHA (line 309, `triggerRenderDeploy`), with retry logic for "commit not yet ingested"
6. **Polls live `/health`** endpoint and compares its commit SHA to GitHub HEAD (line 319, `probeProductionHealth`)
7. Returns full proof: `GITHUB_PUSHED`, `GITHUB_HEAD_SHA`, `RENDER_DEPLOY_TRIGGERED`, `MATCH_GITHUB_TO_HEALTH`, etc.

**Body params:** `{ message?: string; timeoutMs?: number; healthAttempts?: number }`

**This is the most complete push+deploy+verify endpoint, but it REQUIRES owner auth.**

**File:** `backend/services/ivx-deployment-tools/github-tool.ts` (393 lines)

### `getToken()` (line 90)
```typescript
function getToken(): string {
  return (process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN ?? '').trim();
}
```
Reads **only** from `process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN`. Does **NOT** check Owner Variables (unlike the admin-sync and autonomy endpoints). No fallback.

### `ghFetch()` (line 105)
All GitHub API calls go through `ghFetch`, which uses `Authorization: Bearer ${token}`. If no token, returns error.

### Methods that push commits/files to GitHub
**NONE.** This file is **entirely read-only.** It has:
- `getRepoInfo()` — GET repo
- `getBranches()` — GET branches
- `getLatestCommit()` — GET commit
- `createBranch()` (line 204) — POST `/repos/{repo}/git/refs` — **creates a branch ref** (write operation, but not exposed via the public invoke handler)
- `createPullRequest()` (line 224) — POST `/repos/{repo}/pulls` — **creates a PR** (write operation, but not exposed via the public invoke handler)
- `getWorkflows()`, `getWorkflowRuns()`, `getSecrets()`, `verifyPermissions()`, `getFullGitHubStatus()` — all read-only

**Important:** `createBranch()` and `createPullRequest()` are **defined but never called by the public invoke handler.** They exist as library functions but are not wired to any unauthenticated endpoint. The public `handleInvoke` only calls the read-only methods (`getFullGitHubStatus`, `getLatestCommit`, `getBranches`, `verifyPermissions`, `getWorkflowRuns`, `getSecrets`).

6. `createTree()` (line 187) — POST `/repos/{repo}/git/trees` with `base_tree` + tree items (chunked at 100 items)
